name: Yellow clam and white clam
summary: Ngao vàng and ngao trắng are two more names on the 20 June 2013 board. Neither is labeled Phù Long. Ngao vàng is also sold by the piece on one An Tâm II line. The 8 January 2016 article says the island’s seafood is best in winter, before the spring spawn.
howToEat: Order them by weight, or by the piece for ngao vàng on that one line. The cooking method is not given. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Đường 1/4 on the 20 June 2013 board. A current door is Check on arrival. The 20 June 2013 board is a price list. A current price is Check on arrival.
